charity.charity_description: Sandy Hook Promise is a national nonprofit organization founded and led by several family members whose loved ones were killed at Sandy Hook Elementary School on December 14, 2012. The organization honors all victims of gun violence by turning their tragedy into a moment of transformation. Their mission is to educate and empower youth and adults to prevent violence in schools, homes, and communities.

recommendation_copy_dict.copy:
An exciting new type of adventure awaits in Dicefolk, the roguelike deckbuilder with clean, cartoon-inspired visuals, unpredictable encounters, and charming Chimeras. Play as a fabled Chimera Summoner, a member of a tribe of powerful tamers with the unique ability to tame and deploy dozens of powerful monsters to fight your battles and defeat the evil forces threatening your world. Use customized dice to unleash powerful Chimera moves, with no two engagements feeling the same. Say bye-bye to RNG—you have an unprecedented level of influence over each roll of the dice. Each playthrough offers unique Chimeras to befriend, new strategies to deploy, and countless hours of replayability. Can you master the Chimeras’ power before it’s too late?

Keys expire. Please redeem your key before August 4th, 2027.

Drop Duchy - Complete Edition offers an inventive take on the roguelite genre by integrating fast-paced falling block mayhem, base-building, and card battler mechanics. Each falling block uniquely helps your duchy (a Western European village) expand in fun and unpredictable ways. Collect resources and recruit troops to defend your territory as every block fluidly shapes your next move—and if you are defeated, simply try again with the experience you’ve gained!

The Complete Edition includes the official soundtrack composed by Jean-Claude Charlier, alongside new tools and factions from The Tribe and The North DLCs, to keep your fast-paced dukedom growing mightily!

recommendation_copy_dict.copy:
Unmatched speed meets smooth gunplay in Neon White. You play as the titular protagonist, an exiled assassin from Hell with one shot at escaping the flames for the endless light of Heaven. Leverage your unmatched agility, light grappling abilities, and pinpoint accuracy to speedrun expertly crafted maps and compete for the fastest time. Roguelike elements via skill cards offer massive shortcuts and endless replayability. Don’t get lost looking at the beautiful scenery—if you don’t win, you’ll be on the fast track back to Hell.

Keys expire. Please redeem your key before August 4th, 2027.

Our Adventurer Guild offers inspired retro PC styling with all the comforts of modern party-based RPGs. Become the newest Guild Master and lead your adventurers on a journey through epic dungeons filled with unknown monsters and treasure. The grid-based battles rely on sharp tactical planning and the unique Bravery System to turn the tides and push your adventurers past their limits. Choose from a memorable roster of maniacs to grow alongside you as each battle intensifies. Customize your loadout with finely tuned crafting and branching skill trees as you explore your journey to the top. Will the Guild thrive under your leadership—or will it crumble in your hands?

Keys expire. Please redeem your key before August 4th, 2027.

Become a badged defender of the law in Police Simulator: Patrol Officers, the most realistic policing sim on the market. Protect and serve the fictional city of Brighton and experience the unpredictable day-to-day life of a police officer. Cite loiterers, find wanted individuals, and solve crime scene mysteries using the Intuition System to find important clues. A dynamic traffic system organically creates accidents, speeding vehicles, traffic jams, and more, so no two stops are the same. Take a tough but fair approach as your reputation grows, unlocking new neighborhoods to patrol and police vehicles to drive. Make the city of Brighton respect your authority when you boot up Police Simulator: Patrol Officers!

Keys expire. Please redeem your key before August 4th, 2027.

Defend your realm against the monstrous forces of The Fleshmancer as one of the Children of the Solstice—powerful sun and moon magic users capable of performing world-saving Eclipse Magic in Sea of Stars: Sunset Edition. The turn-based battle systems you expect from a traditional-style JRPG are modernized with devastating multi-character combos, split-second counterattacks, no random encounters, and no mindless grinding! Exploration in Sea of Stars feels unique and untethered, as you are free to explore the world by swimming or using your grappler to traverse forests, caves, and more. Claim your place as a hero among the stars as a solo adventurer, in 3-player couch co-op, or online with friends in this award-winning JRPG adventure today!

Feel the thrill and exhilaration of hitting the backcountry from the comfort of your couch in Sledders! It takes real skill and technique to master the slopes—juggle shifting your weight, hitting the throttle, and executing precise maneuvers. Weave between trees and barrel down mountains in the most detailed snowsled sim around.

Realistic physics? Check. A massively detailed map? Check. Fun? Triple check! Take on your friends in two-player co-op, challenge like-minded sledheads in online multiplayer, or simply relax and enjoy offline single-player mode. With more maps on the horizon, Sledders is only getting bigger and better!

What do you get when you mix big-time action game mechanics with a courageous and lovable fox protagonist? TUNIC! Explore a land filled with lost legends, magical powers, and ferocious monsters as you fight to revive your ruined homeland. The visuals may be cute, but the action is palpable—parry and dodge your opponents with dynamic combos, powerful spells, and sharp swordplay. Armed with your mighty blade and an original soundtrack by Lifeformed, your journey moves at an energetic pace. TUNIC’s unique Instruction Booklet feature reveals tricks and tips about the world as you collect the literal lost pages of this sacred text to help you uncover its many, many secrets. Be brave, little fox!
